name: 98513 · Olympia, WA
findings: ZIP 98513 (Olympia) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98513 (Olympia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
